# Sahaba Travels & Forex

> Sahaba Travels and Forex Private Limited (CIN U79110MH2025PTC441982) is a travel agency and foreign-exchange office in Nagpada, Mumbai, India, offering Umrah and Hajj packages, family and honeymoon holidays, religious tours, visa assistance, flights, hotels and currency exchange.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Sahaba Travels and Forex Private Limited
- CIN: U79110MH2025PTC441982 (ROC Mumbai, incorporated 4 March 2025)
- Director: Khan Faisal — https://www.linkedin.com/in/khan-faisal-7564a543
- Address: Shop No. 2, Arsiwala Building, Dimtimkar Road, Nagpada, Mumbai – 400008, Maharashtra, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97690 47633, +91 90820 17919
- Email: info@sahabatravels.com
- Hours (IST): Monday–Friday 10:00 AM–9:00 PM; Saturday 10:00 AM–6:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Languages: English, Hindi, Urdu, Marathi, Gujarati
